# `recordings` fixture (feature 014)

Six recording sessions, one file each (`r1.csv` … `r6.csv`), of 450, 517, 600, 389, 702 and 498
rows: none a multiple of 64, so a window grid that ran across files would shift from file to file.
Every file holds alternating stretches of `idle` and `move` (90–169 rows each). Columns: `label`,
`a`, `b`, `c`. Generated by `make.py`; `tests/unit/test_windows_recordings.py` checks that the
committed files are what it writes.

The sibling fixtures of feature 014 are `soc/` (a continuous number to predict, two files) and
`bursts/` (20-row `dos` bursts every 200 `normal` frames, one file); each generator's docstring says
what it proves.
